Every ticket type

No Ticket Details export was included in this run, so the ticket data isn't available.

Source: Megatix › Reports › Completed Orders Detail for the five 2027 XXL events, exported each morning. Sold = paid web checkouts, VIP upgrades included: resales and $0 / 100%-discount orders are left out; every ticket in a bundle deal (Buy 1 Get 1 Free, Buy 3 Get 1 Free, 2x/3x deals) counts as sold, the free one included (Lauren 04/11); comps = complimentary + consignment. Megatix's Total Sales chart shows the free bundle tickets as Comp/Additional, so it can read a little lower. Days run on Perth time, the same as the Megatix Total Sales chart.
Channels follow the rows in the DAILY SALES sheets (Promoters, Emails & Texts, Socials, Local DJs, Affiliates, TikTok/YouTube, Ads, Untracked), except that Website direct (the WEBSITE link plus the BACKSTAGE10 pop-up code) is shown on its own rather than inside Ads and Emails & Texts, and Call centre (the FRIEND codes) and Birthdays (the BIRTHDAY and BDAY codes) are shown on their own rather than inside Socials, and Google (the GOOGLE ads link) is shown on its own rather than inside Ads (Lauren 27/10), and Flows (DG10, FOLLOWER50 and any UNLOCK link) is shown on its own rather than inside Emails & Texts (Lauren 05/11). VIP upgrades are listed per city under Where sales came from, outside that table's total; since 22/10 they are included in Tickets sold (Lauren). FRIEND sales count as Call centre on every show (Adelaide included). A VIP upgrade bought with a FRIEND code is shown on the Call centre line (so FRIEND counts match Megatix's code reports) but is still not counted as a ticket sold or in the total (Lauren 20/10).
Links used with a discount code (Lauren 05/11): when an order has a link and a discount code from different channels, the code gets the credit and the ticket is counted once. Under Where sales came from, a city cell shows (the normal count) and, in bold, the count including tickets bought through that channel's link; the Incl. links column shows (+ those tickets) and the channel total with them. These are not added to the Total, the team bonus or the DAILY SALES sheets.
